title: Sherlock 2.2 is here!
release_notes:
### 🌐 5,200+ Platforms OSINT (Maigret 0.6.6)
• Engine database doubled: 5,200+ enabled networks, 5,897 total
• Recursive search on by default: expands from discovered IDs and profile links
• Category presets: Social, Coding, Gaming, Forums, Crypto, Dating + country chips
• Scope to Filter: one tap scans exactly what the category chip shows

### 📧 Email OSINT Rebuilt (holehe-v2)
• 181 validators with modern fingerprints and per-platform timeouts
• Honest results: rate limits separated from dead endpoints and rotted parsers
• Rich cards: avatars, bios, logins, and SSO types from every check
• New exports: CSV, JSON, TXT, Markdown, HTML

### 🛡 Results You Can Trust
• Bot-protection badges with the exact cause and a fix suggestion
• Typed failures: bot wall, rate limit, connection failure shown apart
• Keyword badges on claimed accounts matching your terms
• Evidence Communities in Identity Network Analysis

### 📄 Dossiers, Graph & Safety
• PDF with tappable links, page numbers, avatar cards; XMind evidence links
• Interactive graph viewer + Neo4j Cypher export
• Biometric History lock, in-app back button, offline startup font
• ~21MB smaller install, 229 tests, CI gates on every build
